title: Padding commutes with an action
statement: Let $k$ and $K$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a set of states, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word. For every action $a$ on $k$ work tapes and configuration $c$ on those tapes with input $x$, applying the action padded to $K$ tapes to the configuration padded to $K$ tapes gives the same configuration as padding to $K$ tapes the result of applying $a$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on $k$ work tapes with input $x$
replaced:
Applying the padded version of an action to the padded version of a
configuration equals padding the result of applying the original action —
including writes at arbitrary cells.
